name: Seeed XIAO ePaper EE02 (13.3")
description: Seeed XIAO ePaper Driver Board EE02 (ESP32-S3) driving a 13.3" T133A01 6-colour Spectra E6 panel (1200x1600). Same wire format as the reTerminal E1004 and the Waveshare 13.3E6 target; server-side pack via esp32_bin produces a raw 4-bpp Spectra 6 buffer (960000 bytes) the firmware paints without on-device decode. Battery state is reported as unknown for now, sense pin not yet wired in the reference board.
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware. Frame is byte-identical to the seeed_reterminal_e1004 and waveshare_133e6 targets: 960000 bytes exactly (1200*1600/2), two pixels per byte with high nibble = LEFT (even column), low nibble = RIGHT (odd column), row-major, 600 bytes per row, top-left origin. Palette nibbles match the firmware's Spectra 6 constants byte-for-byte (black=0x0, white=0x1, yellow=0x2, red=0x3, blue=0x5, green=0x6; 0x4 and 0x7 reserved). Renderer keeps normal top-left orientation; if hardware testing surfaces a physical flip, the firmware rotates on-device rather than the server pre-rotating.
